claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition, just buy and use.

This is seller behavior text; it does not verify condition or functionality.

risks.risk: Machine may not stitch properly (timing/gear issues, motor problem, or tension problems) even if it looks clean.
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine sewing a straight line on fabric (with needle threaded) plus a close-up of the stitch quality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used and not guaranteed to work perfectly (worst case: needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incorrect parts (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, needle, spool pin, manual).
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, power cord, manual) and a list of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: buyer may need to buy missing parts).

risks.risk: Electrical/power issue (faulty plug, pedal not working, inconsistent motor speed).
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord/plug and a short clip showing the motor running when the pedal is pressed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if electrical function is uncertain (worst case: may require repair).

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage or hidden wear not visible from this distance (cracks, rust around needle plate, bent needle bar).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle plate area, bobbin compartment, underside/hinges, and any visible screws/rollers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used condition until close-ups confirm otherwise.

proof_requests: Send a short video of the machine sewing (straight stitch) on fabric with the needle threaded.
Send close-up photos of the needle plate, bobbin compartment, and stitch/tension controls.
Show the power cord/plug and a clip of the motor running with the pedal.
List and photograph all accessories included (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, spool pin, manual).
response.reason: The photo shows an electric sewing machine with a pedal, but the brand/model text is not readable and there is no proof of working condition. To price safely in Rivers, Nigeria, we need a stitching test and close-ups of key parts.
